4) Given equation $2\cos^2\theta + 3\sin\theta - 3 = 0$
or, $2(1 - \sin^2\theta) + 3\sin\theta - 3 = 0$
or, $2(1 + \sin\theta)(1 - \sin\theta) - 3(1 - \sin\theta) = 0$
or, $(1 - \sin\theta)\{2(1 + \sin\theta) - 3\} = 0$
or, $(1 - \sin\theta)\{2\sin\theta - 1\} = 0$

$\therefore 1 - \sin\theta = 0$ or, $2\sin\theta - 1 = 0$
or, $\sin\theta = 1$ or, $2\sin\theta = 1$
or, $\sin\theta = \sin 90^\circ$ or, $\sin\theta = \frac{1}{2}$
or, $\theta = 90^\circ$ or, $\sin\theta = \sin 30^\circ$
or, $\theta = 30^\circ$

$\theta$ is an acute angle, so $\theta = 30^\circ$.
